issues_detected.title: Severe Rust on Furnace
issues_detected.description: The furnace casing shows significant rust and corrosion, particularly on the front panel. This indicates potential moisture issues and could compromise the structural integrity of the unit.
issues_detected.recommendation: Immediate evaluation by a licensed HVAC technician is recommended to assess the extent of the damage and determine if repair or replacement is necessary.

analysis.overall_assessment: The furnace exhibits severe rust, which may affect its functionality and safety. Prompt professional assessment is advised.
